title: Cad Play Vertex Edge Kernel Solid
description: CAD play: moving vertices or edges produces wrong boxy blocky solids and overlapping shapes. Fix kernel solid computation on topology edit.
summary: Fixed fundamental solid display: committed shading is only brepjs mesh(ValidSolid) via meshTransferFromBrep. Removed solid() weld fallback that could compound faces into box-like chunks; extrude/offset no longer inject meshFaceModelDiff placeholder topology. Kernel-authored solids (empty shellIds) preserve WASM brep across sync. Pick highlights use B-rep wireframes instead of axis-aligned boxGeometry overlays per face. Documented pipeline in brepjs AGENTS.md. Tests: 28 brepjs, 58 renderer.
